guides.headline: Switch from Excel to CapVeri in 15 Minutes
guides.subheadline: Automate CAM reconciliation without changing your ERP or workflows
introParagraphs: Excel has been the default CAM reconciliation tool for decades, not because it is the best option, but because it was already installed on every property manager's computer. The result is thousands of commercial real estate teams running multi-million-dollar reconciliations on a tool that was never designed for the job.

CapVeri replaces the spreadsheet, not your entire workflow. You keep your ERP, your GL exports, and your lease files. The only thing that changes is the error-prone middle step where formulas break, versions multiply, and audit trails disappear.

whySwitch.title: Formula Errors Cost Real Money
whySwitch.description: A single misplaced cell reference in an Excel reconciliation can cascade through an entire building's tenant allocations. Research on real-world spreadsheets keeps finding errors in a large share of the files studied, and CAM reconciliations are no exception.

whySwitch.title: No Audit Trail
whySwitch.description: When a tenant disputes a charge, Excel cannot show who changed what and when. You are left reconstructing months of edits from file names like 'CAM_Recon_v3_FINAL_revised.xlsx'.

whySwitch.title: Version Control Chaos
whySwitch.description: Multiple team members editing copies of the same workbook leads to conflicting numbers, lost changes, and hours spent reconciling the reconciliation itself.

whySwitch.title: No Gross-Up Automation
whySwitch.description: BOMA 2024 gross-up calculations require occupancy tracking, expense pool classification, and variable-base-year adjustments. In Excel, this means dozens of manual formulas per building per year.

migrationSteps.title: Run Your First Reconciliation
migrationSteps.description: Click reconcile and review the automated calculations. CapVeri applies BOMA-aligned gross-up, enforces cap limits, and generates a detailed audit trail for every line item.

whatChanges: Reconciliation calculations automated
Audit trail generated automatically
BOMA 2024 gross-up built in
Cap enforcement tracked per lease

faqs.question: Can I import my existing Excel reconciliation data?
faqs.answer: Yes. CapVeri accepts CSV and Excel files directly. You can upload historical GL data to establish baselines and compare against prior-year reconciliations.

faqs.question: Do I need to switch my ERP system?
faqs.answer: No. CapVeri works alongside any ERP. You continue using Yardi, MRI, AppFolio, or whatever system you use today. CapVeri ingests the CSV/Excel exports those systems already produce.

faqs.question: What happens to my historical Excel reconciliations?
faqs.answer: Your existing files remain untouched. You can keep prior-year Excel files as reference while running new reconciliations in CapVeri, and upload historical data for year-over-year comparison.

faqs.question: How does CapVeri handle formulas differently than Excel?
faqs.answer: CapVeri uses deterministic, audited calculation engines rather than user-editable formulas. Every calculation is versioned, traceable, and validated against BOMA standards. No broken cell references, no hidden circular dependencies.

faqs.question: Is there a learning curve?
faqs.answer: If you can use Excel, you can use CapVeri. The interface is designed for property managers and accountants, not software engineers. You can finish a first reconciliation in one short session.

guides.headline: Replace Your Manual CAM Reconciliation Workflow
guides.subheadline: Automate the tedious, error-prone parts while keeping full control
introParagraphs: Manual CAM reconciliation is a rite of passage in commercial real estate accounting. Every year, teams spend weeks pulling GL data, cross-referencing lease terms, calculating pro-rata shares, applying gross-up factors, and checking cap limits, all by hand or in disconnected spreadsheets. The process works until it does not: a misread lease clause, a transposed number, or a missed cap limit can mean thousands of dollars in billing errors.

CapVeri automates the calculation-intensive middle of the reconciliation process while leaving you in full control of inputs and outputs. You still decide which expenses are recoverable, how leases should be interpreted, and when to send tenant statements. The software just makes sure the math is right every time.

whySwitch.title: Human Error Is Inevitable at Scale
whySwitch.description: Manual reconciliation involves thousands of individual data points per building: GL line items, tenant square footages, pro-rata shares, expense pool classifications, and cap calculations. Even a 1% error rate compounds across a portfolio into material financial exposure.

whySwitch.title: Time Wasted on Repetitive Calculations
whySwitch.description: Manual reconciliation eats hours of staff time on every building. Across a portfolio, that adds up to days of repeat work each year. Software does the same math in minutes.

whySwitch.title: No Scalability
whySwitch.description: Adding buildings to a manual reconciliation workflow means adding proportional staff time. There is no efficiency gain at scale because every building requires the same step-by-step manual process.

whySwitch.title: Inconsistent Methodology
whySwitch.description: When multiple team members handle reconciliations manually, each person may interpret lease language differently, apply gross-up at different stages, or handle cap limits inconsistently. This creates portfolio-wide discrepancies that are difficult to detect and correct.

migrationSteps.title: Export Your GL Data
migrationSteps.description: Pull expense data from your ERP system in CSV or Excel format. This is the same export you already use for manual reconciliation, no new data extraction required.

migrationSteps.title: Upload and Map Data
migrationSteps.description: Upload your GL export to CapVeri. The system auto-detects common ERP formats and maps columns automatically. Review and adjust any mappings the system flags for confirmation.

migrationSteps.title: Enter Lease Terms
migrationSteps.description: Input tenant lease terms including rentable square footage, pro-rata share percentages, expense stop or base year amounts, cap structures, and gross-up election. CapVeri validates entries for internal consistency.

migrationSteps.title: Review Automated Reconciliation
migrationSteps.description: CapVeri generates the complete reconciliation with expense allocations, gross-up calculations, cap enforcement, and tenant-level billing summaries. Review the results, drill into any line item, and export tenant statements.

whatChanges: Calculations automated with full audit trail
Gross-up applied consistently per BOMA standards
Cap limits enforced automatically per lease terms
Reconciliation time drops from hours to minutes
Every number traceable to source data
whatStays: Your existing review and approval workflow

faqs.question: Will I lose control over the reconciliation process?
faqs.answer: No. CapVeri automates calculations, not decisions. You still control which expenses are recoverable, how lease terms are interpreted, and when tenant statements go out. The software ensures the math is consistent and auditable.

faqs.question: How do I verify CapVeri's calculations are correct?
faqs.answer: Every calculation includes a full audit trail showing the source data, formula applied, and intermediate results. You can drill into any line item to see exactly how it was computed. You can validate by running CapVeri alongside your manual process for the first cycle.

faqs.question: What if my manual process includes steps CapVeri does not cover?
faqs.answer: CapVeri focuses on the calculation-intensive core of reconciliation: expense allocation, gross-up, cap enforcement, and tenant billing. Pre-reconciliation steps like expense classification and post-reconciliation steps like tenant communication remain in your control.

faqs.question: How long does the transition take?
faqs.answer: You can finish a first automated reconciliation in one short session. The learning curve is small because CapVeri uses the same inputs you already work with: GL data and lease terms. There is no system migration or data conversion required.

faqs.question: Can CapVeri handle our unique lease structures?
faqs.answer: CapVeri supports NNN, modified gross, full-service gross, and hybrid lease structures. It handles multiple gross-up methods (BOMA 2017 and 2024), cumulative and compounding caps, custom expense pools, and variable base years. If you can calculate it manually, CapVeri can automate it.

introParagraphs: Switching from Yardi to CapVeri does not mean replacing Yardi. It means moving the verification step out of the ERP that produced the reconciliation and into a focused layer built to check gross-up, caps, pro-rata shares, and source GL lines.

The operational win is speed and proof. Your team exports the same Yardi data it already uses, uploads it to CapVeri, reviews exceptions, and exports an audit-ready packet without opening a new implementation project.

whySwitch.title: Setup and training burden
whySwitch.description: Recent Yardi complaint themes cluster around learning curve, setup, and support friction. CapVeri narrows the workflow to the reconciliation proof steps controllers need during close.

whySwitch.title: Configuration drift is hard to spot
whySwitch.description: Yardi can calculate correctly against stale or misconfigured recovery settings. CapVeri reruns the math from exported data and lease terms so drift becomes reviewable.

whySwitch.title: Audit backup needs to be easier to retrieve
whySwitch.description: Tenant questions require source lines, formulas, and a clear explanation. CapVeri packages the calculation trace instead of forcing a report hunt.

faqs.question: Do I need to migrate away from Yardi?
faqs.answer: No. CapVeri is an independent verification layer. Keep Yardi as the system of record and upload Yardi exports when you need CAM proof.

faqs.question: Which CapVeri package should a Yardi user start with?
faqs.answer: Start with Reconcile for core verification, use Control for portfolio analysis and exception management, and use Defend for tenant-facing dispute and audit-defense workflows.

faqs.question: What happens if CapVeri does not match Yardi?
faqs.answer: Treat the variance as an exception to investigate. CapVeri shows the source data, lease terms, and calculation steps so your team can identify whether the issue is Yardi configuration, source data, or CapVeri setup.
